text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Watch out, everyone.
This place seems real dangerous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか暗くて、
やばそうな感じさー
みんな気をつけるさー

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aww... 
The door to Wonderland's nowhere in sight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぅ……
不思議の国への扉、
見つかりまへんわ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I'm rather fond of this place!
But wait, its depths stretch even further!
Consider me excited! Let us proceed onwards, my friends!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
わらわにとっては過ごしやすい空気じゃな！
お、
まだ奥がありそうじゃのう！
わらわも楽しくなってきたぞ！
　行くぞ、
お主ら！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Think we'll make it to Wonderland if we keep goin'?
text_block_list.orig_text:
奥に行けば、
不思議の国に行けるやろかー？
